name: pcbway_2layer
process: Standard PCB (the 'PCB Capabilities - Standard PCB' table); values from the 'Advanced PCB' table are not used

source.title: PCB Capabilities - PCBWay (table: PCB Capabilities - Standard PCB)
source.page_date_note: The page shows no last-updated date. Re-check before relying on it.

clearance_default_min_mm.note: Interpretation, as in jlcpcb_2layer: applied to copper pairs the table gives no specific row for.

pth_annular_ring_min_mm.quote: For pads with vias in the middle, Min width for Annular Ring is 0.15mm(6mil).

via_diameter_over_hole_min_mm.quote: For pads with vias in the middle, Min width for Annular Ring is 0.15mm(6mil).
via_diameter_over_hole_min_mm.note: Interpretation: a 0.15 mm ring on each side, so the via diameter is at least the hole + 0.30 mm.

via_hole_min_mm.quote: Min drill size is 0.15mm, max drill is 6.0mm.

drill_min_mm.quote: Min drill size is 0.15mm, max drill is 6.0mm.

via_hole_to_hole_min_mm.quote: not in the standard table (the Advanced PCB table's 'Hole to hole spacing' is not used)

copper_to_edge_min_mm.quote: not in the standard table (the Advanced PCB table's 'Line to board edge distance' is not used)

solder_mask_web_min_mm.quote: not in the standard table (the Advanced PCB table gives 4 mil for green mask; not used)

silk_line_width_min_mm.quote: Characters of less than 0.15mm wide will be too narrow to be identifiable.
silk_line_width_min_mm.note: The row is the character stroke width; applied to all silkscreen lines.

silk_text_height_min_mm.quote: Characters of less than 0.8mm high will be too small to be recognizable.
